concerns.text: Task T012 restricts data loading to 'ml-latest-small' (MovieLens) only. Spec FR-001 and Constitution Principle VI explicitly mandate support for 'Amazon Books, Last.fm, MovieLens'. The task silently weakens the requirement to a single dataset, violating the spec's scope.

Task T015 implements 'Beam Search (B=50)' for path generation. Spec FR-003 explicitly requires a 'standard greedy heuristic' for the baseline comparison. Replacing the baseline with Beam Search alters the experimental control defined in the spec, violating the requirement to compare against a standard greedy approach.

Task T027 describes sweeping 'decision cutoffs' without specifying the parameter or values. Spec FR-006 requires a concrete set (e.g., {0.01, 0.05, 0.1}) and specific parameters (threshold or path length). The task omits these critical acceptance criteria, risking incomplete validation of the sensitivity analysis requirement.

Task T031 only implements 'monitoring' (logging) of RAM/runtime. Spec SC-003/SC-004 and Constitution Principle VII require the system to 'enforce strict caps' and handle resource constraints (e.g., sampling if >7GB). Monitoring alone does not satisfy the requirement to prevent execution failure or exceedance.

Task T029 implements a 'warning flag' for SC-005 (mean absolute difference ≥ 0.01). The spec defines SC-005 as a measurable outcome to be 'verified' and reported. A warning flag is insufficient; the task must include logic to formally record and report this metric in the final `results/final_report.md` as a pass/fail status.
